about_the_game:
Boomer shooter meets Vampire Survivors – in VR.

A single player VR arena shooter set in a neon soaked cyberpunk city built into the clouds.

An alien crystal changed the world. Now, corporations rule with weaponized addiction and you’re the one thing standing in their way.

Run, shoot and survive in a brutal combat loop. Slay mutants, crush cybernetically enhanced enemies and stack upgrades until you're an unstoppable killing machine. Break the system. Burn it down.

The Story

When an asteroid struck Earth, it brought with it an alien crystal with mysterious properties. Crystals now grow high above ground and humanity built towering vertical cities to harvest them.

But contact with the unrefined mineral causes horrific mutations.

Corporations continue to mine the crystals with disregard for safety protocols, resulting in workers being unintentionally mutated due to negligence and unsafe conditions. Meanwhile, they sell addictive, subscription based enhancements derived from processed crystal to a society too dependent to question it.

Their robot enforcers designed as corporate controlled police maintain order with brutal efficiency.

You've seen what the mineral really does.

You don’t like what you saw.

So you’re going to change it with steel, fire and crystal.

Core Features

  • Be the nightmare: Play as a rebel in fast-paced VR combat.

  • Fast, fluid combat: Keep moving, dodge bullets and dish out destruction.

  • A city full of enemies: Addicted, cybernetically enhanced humans, mutated workers and towering bosses all backed by corporate robot police.

  • Weapon customization to the extreme: Stack mods, add attachments and create completely busted builds.

  • Cybernetic self-enhancement: Upgrade your body with powerful implants and modifications based on the alien mineral.

  • Deep progression systems: Unlock upgrades, perks and long term rogue lite mechanics.

Replayable structure: Challenges, randomized elements, multiple game modes and global leaderboards.

A Living, Dying World

  • Vertical, handcrafted cyberpunk arenas bathed in neon light.

  • Stylized pixel art environments with sharp contrast and moody lighting.

  • Dynamic weather and lighting to match the chaos.

  • An adaptive original soundtrack shifting from dark synths to heavy metal, reacting to the context and intensity of the moment.

content_descriptors.notes: UNKIND contains stylized violence, death, blood effects, and dismemberment in a sci-fi setting. Combat involves killing human, mutant and robotic enemies in a brutal and exaggerated manner.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR compatible VR headset required
